summary: Harden JSONL stream I/O, symlink traversal, number/surrogate bounds, RFC3339 subseconds, and URI traversal

delivery.outcome: Harden standard/jsonl_check.py (< 500L) against symlink-parent traversal, non-regular files, unbounded streams, 5000-digit integers, overflow floats, lone UTF-16 surrogates, deep nesting, 7-9 digit RFC3339 fractional seconds, and URI traversal; sync profiles/dsl-manifest.json digest; expand standard/test_jsonl_check.py; and mark merged ticket-005 DONE.
nonGoals: Do not modify contracts/jsonl.contract.json wire schema keys or break valid existing candidate/record streams
Do not introduce third-party runtime dependencies

architecture.decision: Enforce O_NOFOLLOW regular-file stream reading with symlink-ancestor checks, finite JSON number/surrogate/depth checks, 1-9 digit RFC3339 subsecond normalization, and URI traversal guards in standard/jsonl_check.py, updating profiles/dsl-manifest.json artifact digest.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-006 branch commit or close the pull request before merge.

commands: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 standard/jsonl_check.py validate --profile candidate --file examples/candidates.jsonl
